title: Exquisite Indulgent German Manchego Pudding
description: A rich and creamy German dessert featuring Manchego cheese and coconut cream, with a unique yeasty and glassy-jelly texture, suitable for Jain-friendly diets. This indulgent treat is perfect for special occasions.
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the yeast and 1 tablespoon of sugar, then add 1/4 cup of warm water and stir to dissolve.
Let the yeast mixture sit for 5 minutes, until it becomes frothy.
In a medium saucepan, combine the coconut cream, Manchego cheese, agar agar powder, lemon juice, and vanilla extract.
Whisk the mixture over medium heat until the agar agar is dissolved and the mixture is smooth.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the yeast mixture and coconut oil.
Pour the mixture into individual serving cups or a large serving dish.
Refrigerate the pudding for at least 4 hours, until it is set and has a glassy-jelly texture.
Just before serving, sprinkle a pinch of sugar on top of each pudding.
Serve the pudding chilled, garnished with fresh fruit or nuts if desired.
